entities.summary: Rúben de Almeida Barbeiro, better known by his stage name Kura, is a Portuguese electro house DJ and record producer. Kura has released tracks through labels such as Hardwell's Revealed Recordings, Flashover Recordings, Musical Freedom, and Spinnin' Records, among others.
